title: 第3213章 真就靠沟通十二颗珠子可衍化十二方小世界第3212章 真水神体残五阶圆满大不了你以身相许吧交流
content_zh:
“你是要我认你为主吗？”
那神级宝物沉默了半晌，才终于又传来一道意念。
王腾眼中精光一闪，问道：“我还不知道你的本体是什么，现在说这些还太早了。”
“……”
那神级宝物再次陷入沉默。
如果它没有感觉错，眼前这人似乎有点挑剔啊！
它好歹是神级宝物，而对方不过是域主级，竟然还挑上了？
这合理吗？
原本它觉得自己如果认对方为主，多少有些屈尊降贵的意思。
可现在看来，对方根本没将它当回事。
这不就尴尬了！
“不要误会，只是我的天赋比较多，所以选择方面嘛，自然也会多一点。”
王腾似乎猜出这神级宝物所想，又补充了一句。
“原来如此！”
那神级宝物恍然，说道：“你的天赋确实不凡，不然我也不会看上你。”
“过奖！过奖！”
王腾笑道：
“怎么样，大家开诚布公的谈一谈如何，也不要遮遮掩掩的了。”
那神级宝物迟疑了一下，说道：“好！”
嗡！

下一刻，随着话音落下，四周的小世界开始波动起来，随即渐渐消失。
王腾愣了一下，没想到这神级宝物还挺干脆。
不过这样也好，总比一直被困住的好。
他心中多少松了口气。
烛魔尊者，天炎尊者等人看到这幅景象，也是不由得愣了一下。
“这是要消散了？”
烛魔尊者连忙道。
“好像是，看来王腾成功了！”天澜远海尊者脸上掠过一丝异色，点头道。
他感觉到了这座小世界的消散，力量不复之前那般恐怖，让人有种浑身一松的感觉。
不过他心中却是极为惊讶，不知道王腾到底是如何做到的。
竟然可以兵不血刃的让这神级宝物收敛小世界。
真就靠沟通？
总觉得有点魔幻！
“莫非王腾真要舍身取义，将自己抵给那神级宝物？”烛魔尊者嘀咕道。
“去，说啥呢！”罗福特没好气的瞪了他一眼，随即看向王腾。
content_en:
"Do you want me to recognize you as my master?"
The god-level treasure was silent for a long time before finally sending another thought.
Wang Teng's eyes flashed and he asked, "I don't know what your true form is yet. It's too early to say this now."
"..."
The god-level treasure fell into silence again.
If it feels right, the person in front of me seems a bit picky!
It is a god-level treasure after all, but the opponent is only a domain lord level, so he still picked it up?
Is this reasonable?
Originally, it felt that if it recognized the other party as its master, it would be somewhat condescending.
But now it seems that the other party doesn't take it seriously at all.
Isn’t this embarrassing!
"Don't get me wrong, it's just that I have more talents, so I naturally have more choices."
Wang Teng seemed to have guessed what this god-level treasure was thinking, and added another sentence.
"That's it!"
The god-level treasure was suddenly enlightened and said, "Your talent is indeed extraordinary, otherwise I wouldn't have taken a fancy to you."
"Thank you! Thank you!"
Wang Teng smiled and said:
"How about we talk about it openly and honestly, and don't be secretive."
The god-level treasure hesitated for a moment and said, "Okay!"
Buzz!
The next moment, as the words fell, the small world around him began to fluctuate, and then gradually disappeared.
Wang Teng was stunned for a moment, but he didn't expect that this god-level treasure was quite simple.
But this is better than being trapped all the time.
He was somewhat relieved.
Venerable Zhu Mo, Venerable Tianyan and others couldn't help but be stunned when they saw this scene.
"Is this going to dissipate?"
Lord Zhu Mo said quickly.
"It seems so. It seems Wang Teng succeeded!" A strange look flashed across the face of Venerable Tianlan Yuanhai and he nodded.
He felt the dissipation of this small world, and its power was no longer as terrifying as before, making people feel relaxed.
However, he was extremely surprised and didn't know how Wang Teng did it.
It turns out that this god-level treasure can control the small world without even a single blow.
Is it really about communication?
It always feels a bit magical!
"Could it be that Wang Teng really wants to sacrifice his life for righteousness and sacrifice himself for that god-level treasure?" Venerable Candle Demon muttered.
"Go, what are you talking about!" Luofut glared at him angrily, and then looked at Wang Teng.
